_comment: A worked findings.json, for the DES-9999 Rev 1 -> Rev 2 fixture pair in
examples/. Copy the shape, not the content. Every row_index and
table_index comes from extract.json -> revision_history; never count rows
by hand. All seven checks appear in summary, including passes and N/A.

revision_history_notes.text: Revision column reads 3 but the page header reads Rev. 2. One of the two is wrong.
Claimed but not done: no §9 Environmental Monitoring exists in this revision.
Missing entry: the call rate acceptance criterion in §5.2 changed from 95% to 98%.
Missing entry: the document title changed from “NIPT Assay Specification” to “NIPT Assay Validation Specification”.
Missing entry: §4.3 Equipment was renumbered to §4.4; the numbering now skips 4.3.
Missing entry: §6 now reads “The regression sample set is TBD”, replacing the reference to VER-0045 Appendix A.

summary.evidence: Page header reads “DES-9999 - NIPT Assay Specification”; the title on page 1 and the Word document property both read “NIPT Assay Validation Specification”.
Page header reads Rev. 2. The latest revision history entry reads Rev 3 (row 2).

summary.check: Revision history entries evidenced in the body
summary.evidence: Rev 1 “Initial release”: PASS. Rev 3 claims §9 Environmental Monitoring was added; no §9 exists. The storage claim is evidenced: §3 reads 2-8 degrees C.

summary.check: Revision history complete vs previous revision
summary.evidence: Compared against DES-9999 Rev 1. Five real differences are not described by any entry: the title change, §5.2 95% -> 98%, §4.3 -> §4.4 renumbering, the §6 TBD replacing the VER-0045 reference, and the added §1 cross-reference to §9. One claim is not done (§9).
§3 requires storage at 2-8 degrees C; §7 requires samples stored at room temperature (15-25 degrees C). §1 refers to §9, which does not exist.
§2 cites ISO 13485:2003, ISO 15223-1:2016 and “21 CFR 820 Quality System Regulation”. ISO 14971:2019 and CLSI EP17-A2 appear current.
Footer and PAGE/NUMPAGES fields present (PASS). Heading numbering skips 4.3. §6 contains a TBD placeholder. §1 references a non-existent §9. DAISY and NIPT are used without expansion.

recommendations.finding: §3 Storage Conditions requires the kit at 2-8 degrees C. §7 Sample Handling requires samples at room temperature (15-25 degrees C). Both are presented as requirements and they cannot both be met for the same material.
recommendations.suggested_action: Decide which condition controls for which material, state it once, and cross-reference it from the other section.

recommendations.finding: The header title and the document title differ, and the body now covers validation content that the header title does not describe.
recommendations.suggested_action: Align the header, the page 1 title and the Word document property on one title, and confirm it matches the document's scope after this revision.

recommendations.finding: §6 states “The regression sample set is TBD”. A released specification cannot leave a verification input undefined.
recommendations.suggested_action: Restore the reference to VER-0045 Appendix A or define the regression sample set before release.

recommendations.finding: ISO 13485:2003 is cited. The current edition appears to be ISO 13485:2016, reconfirmed in 2025.
recommendations.suggested_action: Update to ISO 13485:2016. Confirm against the controlled standards list.

recommendations.finding: ISO 15223-1:2016 is cited. The current edition appears to be ISO 15223-1:2021, with Amendment 1:2025 applying where the authorised-representative symbol is used.
recommendations.suggested_action: Update to ISO 15223-1:2021 and cite Amd 1:2025 if the EC REP symbol is in scope. Confirm against the controlled standards list.

recommendations.finding: 21 CFR Part 820 is cited as the “Quality System Regulation”. Part 820 has been the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) since 2 February 2026, and it incorporates ISO 13485:2016 by reference.
recommendations.suggested_action: Retitle the citation to the Quality Management System Regulation and check whether any subpart references still read correctly. Confirm against the controlled standards list.

recommendations.finding: §1 states that environmental monitoring is described in §9. There is no §9 in this revision.
recommendations.suggested_action: Add the section or remove the cross-reference, consistent with whatever the Rev 3 history entry intended.

recommendations.finding: Heading numbering runs 4.1, 4.2, 4.4. There is no 4.3.
recommendations.suggested_action: Renumber 4.4 to 4.3, or add the missing subsection.

recommendations.finding: DAISY and NIPT are used without expansion at first use, and the document has no definitions section.
recommendations.suggested_action: Expand both at first use, or add a definitions section.

recommendations.finding: The footer carries the uncontrolled-copy statement and PAGE/NUMPAGES fields, but no template ID, so template currency could not be checked.
recommendations.suggested_action: Confirm the document is on the current controlled template and that the template ID appears in the footer.
